name: Psychic Phenomena
description: Black Crusade, Table 6-2 (p. 210). Rolled when a power is used Unfettered and the Focus Power Test came up doubles, or whenever a power is Pushed. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.name: Dark Foreboding
results.text: No mechanical effect.

results.name: Warp Echo
results.text: No mechanical effect.

results.name: Unholy Stench
results.text: No mechanical effect.

results.name: Mind Warp
results.text: The psyker takes -5 to Willpower Tests until the start of his next turn.

results.name: Hoarfrost
results.text: Frost covers everything within [[3d10]] metres. No mechanical effect.

results.name: Aura of Taint
results.text: Animals within [[1d100]] metres panic. Psyniscience pinpoints the psyker.

results.name: Memory Worm
results.text: Everyone in line of sight forgets something trivial.

results.name: Spoilage
results.text: Food and drink spoil within [[5d10]] metres.

results.name: Haunting Breeze
results.text: Winds scatter light objects and gutter fires within [[3d10]] metres.

results.name: Veil of Darkness
results.text: Darkness within [[3d10]] metres for the rest of the round. Apply darkness modifiers to attacks.

results.name: Distorted Reflections
results.text: Reflective surfaces distort or shatter within [[5d10]] metres.

results.name: Breath Leech
results.text: Everyone within [[3d10]] metres, psyker included, may not Run or Charge for one round.

results.name: Daemonic Mask
results.text: The psyker gains Fear (1) until the start of the next turn and gains 1 Corruption Point.

results.name: Unnatural Decay
results.text: Plant life dies within [[3d10]] metres.

results.name: Spectral Gale
results.text: Psyker and everyone within [[4d10]] metres: Easy (+30) Agility or Strength Test or be knocked Prone.

results.name: Bloody Tears
results.text: Stone and wood weep blood within [[3d10]] metres.

results.name: The Earth Protests
results.text: Everyone within [[5d10]] metres, psyker included: Routine (+10) Agility Test or be knocked Prone.

results.name: Actinic Discharge
results.text: Unprotected electronics short out within [[5d10]] metres.

results.name: Warp Ghosts
results.text: Everyone within [[3d10]] metres except the psyker must test against Fear (1).

results.name: Falling Upwards
results.text: Everything within [[2d10]] metres, psyker included, rises [[1d10]] metres and falls. Apply Falling Damage for the distance.

results.name: Banshee Howl
results.text: Every mortal creature that can hear it, psyker included: Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or Deafened for [[1d10]] rounds.

results.name: The Furies
results.text: The psyker is knocked Prone, takes [[1d5]] Damage ignoring armour but not Toughness Bonus, and must test against Fear (2).

results.name: Shadow of the Warp
results.text: Everyone within [[1d100]] metres, psyker included: Difficult (-10) Willpower Test or gain [[1d5]] Corruption Points.

results.name: Tech Scorn
results.text: All ranged weapons within [[5d10]] metres Jam. Characters with cybernetics: Routine (+10) Toughness Test or take [[1d5]] Damage ignoring Toughness Bonus and armour.

results.name: Warp Madness
results.text: All creatures within [[2d10]] metres except the psyker: Difficult (-10) Willpower Test or become Frenzied for a round and gain [[1d5]] Corruption Points.

results.name: Perils of the Warp
results.text: Roll on Perils of the Warp instead.
